purpose: Separate source annotation policy from morphology: an explicit UD_IMST export head, not an all-Turkish correctness claim.
trigger: TRAIN-only audit found different distributions of retained adjective/number POS across BOUN and IMST; initial mixed-head DEV low-strength result was non-improving.
training_subset: Only IMST rows inside the same frozen 10490-sentence TRAIN partition; never evaluation IDs.
reuse: Reuse exactly the original frozen P2 feature rows and E05 offsets, verifying each row's partial-label mask against its source token before selecting IMST.
selection: Strength 1 only if DEV legacy lemma+POS and legacy declared features do not regress against strength 0; otherwise keep 0. Seal before running this variant on CALIB. Never choose a new strength on CALIB.
public_scope: Code, protocol, aggregate results and hash receipts. No source corpus or model weights.
